dct_description_sm: Georeferenced map of Upper Similkameen Band reserves Chuchuwayha 2 and Lulu 5 along the Similkameen River near Hedley. Land cover and features described on the map includes a trail from Princeton, to Keremeus and to Nickle Plate, fields, graves, 20 mile Creek; pastures, a village, and the types of land, soil, and timber.
